title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Improperly Tightened Rear Subframe Bolts (3,933 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2026 Pilot and Passport vehicles. The rear subframe bolts may have been tightened improperly.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (325,588 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2018-2020 Odyssey vehicles. Water may enter into the rearview camera, which can cause the rearview camera image to fail to display when the vehicle is in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Integrated Brake System Malfunction (428 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 Mini Cooper S, Mini Countryman S All4, X2, 2024 Rolls-Royce Spectre, 2023-2025 i7, 7 Series, X7, 2024-2025 i5, 5 Series, 2023-2024 XM, X1, 2024-2025 X6, and X5 vehicles. The integrated brake (IB) system may malfunction and result in a loss of power brake assist or cause the Antilock Brake (ABS) and Dynamic Stability Control (DSC) systems to not function properly.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Parking & Daytime Running Lights May Fail/FMVSS 108 (12,592 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Ram 1500 vehicles. The headlight wiring may cause the parking lights and daytime running lights to flicker on and off, or fail. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: WARN Industries, Inc.: Wireless Remote May Fail to Stop Winch (8,574 affected)
summary: Warn Industries, Inc. (WARN) is recalling certain Wireless Remote Kits with part numbers 90287 and 90289. The wireless handheld remote control may be incompatible with some legacy winches, causing the unexpected winch movements.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Park Outside: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire (6 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Ioniq 5 vehicles. The high voltage battery cells may contain misaligned electrodes, which can lead to a fire while parked or driving.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Park Outside: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire (8 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2022-2024 EV6 and 2024 EV9 vehicles. The high voltage battery cells may contain misaligned electrodes, which can lead to a fire while parked or driving.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Park Outside: Fire from Overheated Power Seat Motors (462,869 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Telluride vehicles. The front power seat motor may overheat due to a stuck power seat slide knob or an improper recall 24V407 repair, which can result in a fire while parked or driving.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Incorrectly Routed Inverter AC Wiring May Short and Overheat (277 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Service Body vehicles. The inverter output AC wiring may be routed too tightly in the electrical receptacle enclosure and become damaged, possibly resulting in a short circuit.

title: Crestline Coach Ltd.: Park Outside: Fuel Line May Leak and Cause Fire (23 affected)
summary: Crestline Coach Ltd. (Crestline) is recalling certain 2026 Ford CCL166 TYPE III emergency vehicles. A bolt may puncture the fuel line, causing a fuel leak.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Grounding Connection Not Installed (182 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2026 Heartland Cyclone travel trailers and Cyclone fifth wheel trailers. The inverter may have been installed without a grounding connection.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Grounding Connection Not Installed (205 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2026 Seismic fifth toy haulers. The inverter may have been installed without a grounding connection.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Rear Seat Belts May Not Secure Child Seat/FMVSS 208 (3,788 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2026 LEAF vehicles. The outer rear seat belt automatic locking retractors (ALR) may deactivate early, which can prevent a child restraint system (CRS) from securing properly. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Southeast Toyota Distributors, LLC: Incorrect Load Carrying Capacity Modification Label/FMVSS 110 (1 affected)
summary: Southeast Toyota Distributors, LLC (SET) is recalling one 2026 Tundra truck. The current load carrying capacity modification label is incorrect. As such, this vehicle fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Prime-Time Specialty Vehicles: Wheelchair Restraint Retractor May Not Lock (12 affected)
summary: Prime-Time Specialty Vehicles (Prime-Time) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Ford Med Transit vans equipped with Q'Straint Max wheelchair retractors. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Noncompliant Vehicles Incorrectly Imported/FMVSS 208, 201 (15 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2026 Model Y and 2024 Model 3 vehicles. The vehicles were originally built for a foreign market and do not have knee air bags, may not be equipped with certain interior safety countermeasures, and may not have been tested for bumper impact resistance procedures. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers, 208, "Occupant Crash Protection," 201, "Occupant Protection in Interior Impact," and Part 581, "Bumper Standards."

title: Harbor Freight Tools: Improper Illumination of Towing Lights/FMVSS 108 (3,832 affected)
summary: Harbor Freight Tools (HFT) is recalling certain Kenway 12V LED Towing Light Kits with part number 64282, manufactured November 13, 2019 to December 22, 2019, and 12V Submersible Lights with part number 64274, manufactured July 1, 2019 to July 8, 2019. The lights may not illuminate properly. As such, these lights fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Assoc. Equipment."

title: Subaru of America, Inc.: Incorrect Weight Rating on Label/FMVSS 110 (541,237 affected)
summary: Subaru of America, Inc. (Subaru) is recalling certain 2026 Crosstrek Hybrid, 2025-2026 Forester Hybrid, Forester, and 2019-2026 Ascent vehicles. These vehicles were manufactured with an incorrect Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) on the certification label. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) 110, "Tire selection and rims."

title: Braun Corporation: Braze Connection Missing From Fuel Line (4 affected)
summary: Braun Corporation (Braun) is recalling certain 2026 Chevrolet Traverse vehicles. The fuel fill line may be missing a braze connection, allowing fuel to leak.

title: KTM North America, Inc.: Rear Brake Caliper May Crack and Break (6,257 affected)
summary: KTM North America, Inc. (KTM) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Husqvarna FE 501S, Husqvarna FE 350S, 2024 GasGas ES 350,  and GasGas ES 500 motorcycles. During backwards rolling, the brake caliper may crack near the primary pin casting, which may cause the caliper to break when riding.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: Incorrectly Installed Quick Release Valve/FMVSS 121 (8 affected)
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Peterbilt 579 and 2027 Kenworth T680 tractors. The trailer air connection quick release (QR) valve in the air brake system may have been incorrectly installed, which can cause the trailer to become unstable after the driver applies the brakes. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Park Outside: Engine Starter May Corrode and Overheat (29,119 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2018-2020 530e xDrive, 2017-2019 740Le xDrive, 2018-2020 530e iPerformance, 2016-2018 330e iPerformance vehicles. The engine starter relay may corrode, causing the relay to overheat and short circuit.

title: Shyft Group: Strobe Light May Short Circuit (563 affected)
summary: Shyft Group (Shyft) is recalling certain 2016, 2019, and 2021 Utilimaster Velocity vehicles. Water may enter an improperly sealed strobe light and cause a short circuit.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect GVWR on Federal Placard/FMVSS 120 (18 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Wildwood and Salem travel trailers. The Federal Placard may have the incorrect Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR). As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other than Passenger Cars."

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Rear Axle Carrier May Break (5,408 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2026 Lexus TX Plug-In Hybrid, TX Hybrid, TX, Toyota Grand Highlander Hybrid, and Grand Highlander vehicles. The rear axle carriers may have been manufactured with insufficient material strength and could break.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Loss of Steering Control from Loose Steering Arm Fasteners (3,858 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2026 VOLVO VAH, VN, VHD, 2026-2027 VNL (4) and VNR (4) vehicles. The steering knuckles may have been manufactured with insufficiently tightened steering arms.

title: Zoox, Inc.: ADS Software May Fail to Detect and Respond to Heavy Smoke (105 affected)
summary: Zoox, Inc. (Zoox) is recalling certain Automated Driving Systems (ADS). The ADS software may fail to detect heavy smoke, allowing the vehicle to enter an area of low visibility, particularly active emergency scenes.

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Printed Circuit Board May Overheat (448 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Lineage recreational vehicles equipped with certain MaxxAir N-Series Maxxfan rooftop ventilation fans. The printed circuit board may fail during certain operations and overheat.

title: Ford Motor Company: Second-Row Seat May Move Unexpectedly (387,911 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2027 Aviator and 2020-2026 Explorer vehicles. The switch for the easy-entry second-row outer seats may bind or stick, resulting in the seats unlatching, tipping, or sliding unexpectedly.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Seat Belt Buckle May Fail (47,787 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Kona Electric and 2024-2026 Kona vehicles. The seat belt buckle in the rear center seat may fail to properly restrain an occupant during a crash.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Printed Circuit Board May Overheat (134 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2027 Navion and View recreational vehicles equipped with certain MaxxAir N-Series Maxxfan rooftop ventilation fans. The printed circuit board may fail during certain operations and overheat.

title: Ford Motor Company: Trailer Brakes and Lighting May Be Lost/FMVSS 108 (315 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain ITRM accessory kits with part number RL3Z-19H322-AA,  ML3Z-19H322-AA, AB, BA, BB, CA, and CB that were sold as aftermarket accessory kits for Ford 2021-2026 F-150 vehicles. The integrated trailer module (ITRM) may lose communication with the vehicle, causing a loss of brake function, turn signals and brake lights. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, " Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Wabash National Corporation: Liftgate Deck Pins May Break (4 affected)
summary: Wabash National Corporation (Wabash) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Dry Freight trucks The deck pins may break, resulting in the liftgate platform falling.

title: Ford Motor Company: Roof Rail Covers May Detach (288,314 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2016-2019 Explorer vehicles. The roof rail covers may come loose and detach from the vehicle.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Incorrect GAWR on Certification Label/FMVSS 110 (168,149 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2020-2026 Nissan Armada, 2011-2013 Infiniti QX56, and 2014-2027 QX80 vehicles equipped with 22" wheels. The Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) listed on the certification label is incorrect, which can allow the vehicle to be overloaded. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: E-One Incorporated: Drive Mode May Disengage Causing a Loss of Drive Power (159 affected)
summary: E-One Incorporated (E-One) is recalling certain 2026 Commercial, 2025-2026 Typhoon N, and Cyclone N emergency vehicles. The drive/pump mode transfer case may disengage, causing loss of power to the rear wheels.

title: Orange EV: Frame Rails May Crack (24 affected)
summary: Orange EV is recalling certain 2023-2024 e-TRIEVER, 2020-2023 T-Series Tandem Terminal Truck, and 2024-2026 HUSK-e Tandem Terminal vehicles. Improper welding may cause frame rails to crack, leading to rail separation.

title: International Motors, LLC: Body Panel Joints Incorrectly Attached/FMVSS 221 (50 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025-2027 IC Bus CECB transit buses. The driver's window panel and entrance door vertical joints may have been attached without sufficient epoxy coverage. As such these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) No. 221, "School Bus Body Joint Strength."

title: International Motors, LLC: Body Panel Joints Incorrectly Attached/FMVSS 221 (22,730 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2025-2027 IC Bus EVSB and CESB school buses. The driver's window panel and entrance door vertical joints may have been attached without sufficient epoxy coverage. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) No. 221, "School Bus Body Joint Strength."

title: International Motors, LLC: Battery Cable May Short Circuit (15,628 affected)
summary: International Motors, LLC (International) is recalling certain 2021, 2023-2027 MV, and 2026-2027 HV vehicles. The battery interconnect cable may contact the auxiliary stud and hold down bracket, causing a short circuit.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Water May Damage Rearview Camera (15,535 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Land Rover Discovery vehicles. Water may not be able to drain away from the rearview camera due to insufficient drain holes, which may result in damage to the rearview camera.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Unprotected Boom Stow Wire May Short and Cause Fire (884 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2013-2025 AP45A trucks. The boom stow switch wire in the cargo storage area may become damaged, which can result in a short circuit, causing the wire to overheat.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Steel Wheels May Crack and Separate (641 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2026 Jeep Gladiator and Jeep Wrangler vehicles. The walls for the steel wheels may be too thin, allowing them to crack or detach, which can result in a loss of vehicle control.

title: Great Dane Trailers: Missing Rear Impact Guard Extension Channels/FMVSS 224 (11 affected)
summary: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2027 Champion dry van trailers The trailers may have been produced without the installation of the rear impact guard extension channels.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 224, "Rear Impact Protection."

title: Foretravel, Inc.: Printed Circuit Board May Overheat (3 affected)
summary: Foretravel, Inc. (Foretravel) is recalling certain 2027 Realm Presidential Motorcoaches. The printed circuit board in the MaxxAir Fan assembly may fail during certain operations and overheat.

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: Headrest Position May Shift in a Crash/FMVSS 213 (59,661 affected)
summary: Evenflo Company, Inc. (Evenflo) is recalling certain Reo by Revolve360 child seats in color variants Nantucket, Danvers, Chelsea, Holden, Brookline, and Lenox. Please refer to Evenflo's recall report for the specific models. In certain rear or forward-facing positions, the headrest may shift position during a crash. As such, these child seats fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 213, "Child Restraint Systems."

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Turntable Fasteners Not Heat Treated (309 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2024-2026 AT Series vehicles. The turntable rotation bearing fasteners may not have been heat treated properly.

title: Turtle Top: Wheelchair Lift May Inadvertently Move (0 affected)
summary: Turtle Top is recalling certain 2026 Terra Ford Transit buses. The electrical contactor may fail, preventing the controls from stopping the lift.

title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Compartment Fire (565,691 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2026 Bronco and Bronco Raptor vehicles. The engine compartment wiring harness may become damaged and short circuit.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Brake Fluid Leak May Cause Fire (29 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2022-2027 Vision transit buses. The exhaust hanger cotter pin may contact the hydraulic brake line, damaging the line and causing a brake fluid leak.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: Brake Fluid Leak May Cause Fire (5,096 affected)
summary: Blue Bird Bus Company (Blue Bird) is recalling certain 2022-2027 Vision school buses. The exhaust hanger cotter pin may contact the hydraulic brake line, damaging the line and causing a brake fluid leak.

title: Ford Motor Company: Driver's Seat May Recline Unexpectedly (76,748 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Explorer and Lincoln Aviator vehicles. An unoccupied driver's seat may recline unintentionally during certain scenarios, such as remote unlock or remote start.

title: Ember Recreational Vehicles, INC: Incorrect VIN on Label (33 affected)
summary: Ember Recreational Vehicles, INC. (Ember) is recalling certain 2027 Overland Series, E-Series, and Touring Series travel trailers. The Federal Certification Label may have the incorrect Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) listed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Insufficient Illumination from Low Beam Headlights (23,276 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Freightliner EM2, Freightliner Custom Chassis S2RV, Freightliner Custom Chassis S2C, and Freightliner Business Class M2 vehicles. A software error may cause the low beam headlights to illuminate improperly.

title: Hiab USA Inc.: Crane Column May Fail (996 affected)
summary: Hiab USA Inc. (Hiab) is recalling certain K-HiPro 425 and K-HiPro 505 cranes. Under certain operating conditions, over time the weld between the column pillar and the main plate may fatigue and crack.

title: The Heil Co.: Water in High Voltage Cabinet May Cause Short Circuit (7 affected)
summary: The Heil Co. (Heil) is recalling certain 2025-2026 side loader garbage trucks equipped with certain HH Technologies ReVamp high voltage cabinets, with part number 372-9585. Water may enter an improperly sealed high voltage cabinet and cause component failure or a short circuit.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display (57,851 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling 2024-2026 Atlas Cross Sport and Atlas vehicles.  The vehicles may experience a low-voltage electrical event that affects display screen functions. As a result, the rearview camera image may fail to display as intended.

title: Coach and Equipment Mfg. Corp.: Wheelchair Lift May Inadvertently Move (131 affected)
summary: Coach and Equipment Mfg. Corp. (Coach and Equipment) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Phoenix, and 2025-2026 Metrolite transit buses, equipped with certain S-Series wheelchair platform lifts. The electrical contactor may fail, preventing the controls from stopping the lift.

title: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC): Wireless Remote May Fail to Stop Winch (2 affected)
summary: Aluminum Trailer Company (ATC) is recalling certain 2026 RM500 and RM700 trailers. The wireless handheld remote control may be incompatible with some legacy winches, resulting in unexpected winch movements.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Ignition Lock May Fail and Cause Engine Stall (16,736 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2024 S 1000 RR US, and 2020-2026 S 1000 RR motorcycles. The vibration of the motorcycle may cause an internal component of the ignition lock to fail, which can cause the instrument display, rear lighting, and other systems such as ABS to fail, or cause an engine stall while riding.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Printed Circuit Board May Overheat (69 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Pause travel trailers, and OG Luxury Coach recreational vehicles, equipped with certain MaxxAir N-Series Maxxfan rooftop ventilation fans. The printed circuit board may fail during certain operations and overheat.

title: K&N Engineering, Inc.: Fuel Filter O-Ring May Disintegrate (44,053 affected)
summary: K&N Engineering, Inc. (K&N) is recalling certain K&N and Spectre replacement fuel filters with part numbers KN81-0300, KN81-0301, SPE-2369, SPE-2358, and SPE-6932. The O-ring in the fuel filter may disintegrate, causing a leak.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Water Tank Capacity on Label/FMVSS 110 (804 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2027 Unmapped, Sabre, No Boundaries, Ibex, Surveyor, Sierra, and Sandpiper travel trailers. The Federal Placard may state an incorrect fresh water tank capacity. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: FRONTRUNNER BUS GROUP, INC.: Wheelchair Restraint Retractor May Not Lock (24 affected)
summary: Frontrunner Bus Group, Inc. (Frontrunner) is recalling certain 2025 Frontrunner transit buses. The retractors may not lock, preventing the wheelchair from being properly secured.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Rollaway Risk from Door Switch Failure (310,667 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2020-2021 CLA, 2019-2022 A-Class, 2022-2023 C-Class, 2024 CLE, 2020-2026 GLA/GLB, and 2023-2024 GLC vehicles. Please refer to MBUSA's recall report for specific model information. The micro-switch in the driver's door lock may corrode and fail to detect an open door, preventing the electronic parking brake or "Auto-Park" feature from engaging automatically. This may result in a vehicle rollaway.

title: Midwest Industries, Inc.: Trailer Tongue May Fail (183 affected)
summary: Midwest Industries, Inc. (Midwest) is recalling certain 2027 Yamaha boat trailers. The tongue may fatigue and fail during towing, resulting in the trailer detaching.

title: ARBOC Specialty Vehicles, LLC: Rear Spring Hanger May Detach (502 affected)
summary: ARBOC Specialty Vehicles, LLC (ARBOC) is recalling certain 2017-2026 Spirit of Independence transit buses. The wrong size washers may have been installed on the rear spring hanger bolts.

title: Foretravel, Inc.: Unintended Brake Light Illumination/FMVSS 108 (51 affected)
summary: Foretravel, Inc. (Foretravel) is recalling certain 2025-2027 Realm Presidential and 2025-2026 Realm motorcoaches. The exterior brake lights may remain illuminated when the driver is not applying the brakes. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: PACCAR Incorporated: Oil Contaminated Power Distribution Center/FMVSS 103 (5,925 affected)
summary: PACCAR Incorporated (PACCAR) is recalling certain 2027 Peterbilt and Kenworth vehicles. Please see the recall report for a complete list of models. The power distribution center (PDC) box may be contaminated with oil, which could result in a loss of drive power, Antilock Brake System (ABS) functionality, exterior lighting, windshield wipers, or the defogging system. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 103, "Windshield Defrosting and Defogging Systems," 104, "Windshield Wiping and Washing Systems," and 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Jayco, Inc.: Unintended Brake Light Illumination/FMVSS 108 (265 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2025 Entegra Reatta XL, Reatta, 2026 Cornerstone Reserve, 2024-2026 Cornerstone, Aspire, and Anthem motorhomes built on certain Spartan K1, K2, and K4 chassis. The exterior brake lights may remain illuminated when the driver is not applying the brakes. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Jayco, Inc.: Incorrect Tire Size on Certification Label (5 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2026 Entegra Anthem motorhomes. The tire size may be incorrect on the vehicle certification label. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Incorrect Breaker May Allow Conductor to Overheat (7 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2027 Imagine recreational trailers. The inverter prep circuit conductor may have insufficient overcurrent protection, causing the conductor to overheat.

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Incorrect Tire Pressure Information on Label/FMVSS 120 (10 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Lineage motorhomes equipped with the 20-inch wheel and tire package. The tire information label may state the incorrect rear tire pressure. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 120, "Wheels and Rims - Other than Passenger Cars."

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Incorrectly Secured 120V Outlet May Contact Wiring (2 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2026 Imagine travel trailers. The outlet cover may have been improperly secured, allowing screws to contact wiring.

title: Ford Motor Company: Obstructed Rearview Camera Image/FMVSS 111 (47,587 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2023 F-150 and 2023-2026 F-250 SD vehicles equipped with 8-inch SYNC infotainment screens. A software error may cause the rearview camera image to be obstructed by the infotainment home screen menu when the vehicle is placed in reverse. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Newell Coach Corp.: Steer Axle Air Springs Base May Crack (51 affected)
summary: Newell Coach Corp. (Newell) is recalling certain 2025-2027 P50 coaches. The steer axle air spring base may crack.

title: Ford Motor Company: Window Glass Trim Pieces May Detach (86,543 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023-2025 Mustang Mach E vehicles. The rear side quarter window glass trim may be improperly secured, which can allow it to detach.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Side Curtain Air Bag May Deploy Improperly (1,737 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain side curtain air bag (CSA) assemblies sold as replacement parts for 2014-2021 Toyota Tundra Double Cab and CrewMax vehicles. The side curtain air bag may have been improperly rolled, causing an improper air bag deployment.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Side Curtain Air Bag May Deploy Improperly (2,381 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain side curtain air bag (CSA) assemblies sold as replacement parts for 2016-2023 Toyota Tacoma vehicles. The side curtain air bag may have been improperly secured to its mounting bracket, causing an improper air bag deployment.

title: Autocar, LLC: Antilock Braking System May Fail (137 affected)
summary: Autocar, LLC (Autocar) is recalling certain 2023-2027 E-ACTT terminal tractors. The Antilock Braking System (ABS) Electronic Control Unit (ECU) may be improperly secured, allowing the ABS ECU to separate.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Handlebar Lock Screw May Detach and Interfere with Steering (43,913 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2017-2023, 2025 CMX500, 2017-2023, 2025-2026 CMX300, and 2025 Honda SCL500 motorcycles. The handlebar lock screw may loosen and detach.

title: Brinkley RV: Exterior Ladder May Detach (28 affected)
summary: Brinkley RV (Brinkley) is recalling certain 2027 Model I trailers. The exterior ladder may not be properly secured to the support backer.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Park Outside: Generator May Turn On Without Operator Action (96 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Ekko motorhomes. The touchscreen display may register unintended or phantom inputs and turn the generator on without the operator's knowledge.

title: Wanco, Inc.: Fuel Tank May Crack and Leak (1,129 affected)
summary: Wanco, Inc. (Wanco) is recalling certain Compact Light Towers with part number WLTT. The diesel fuel tank may crack and leak fuel.

title: General Motors, LLC: Steel Wheels May Crack (952 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2026 Chevrolet Silverado EV and GMC Sierra EV vehicles. A manufacturing defect may result in the steel wheels cracking at the disc vent holes.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Improperly Installed Seat Belt Buckle Anchor/FMVSS 210 (1,271,294 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2019-2026 Ram 1500 vehicles. The second-row center and left-side seat belt buckle anchors may have been improperly installed. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 210, "Seat Belt Assembly Anchorages."

title: General Motors, LLC: Improperly Secured Module May Damage High Voltage Battery (11 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC is recalling certain 2026 Cadillac Escalade IQ, Escalade IQL, GMC Sierra EV, Chevrolet Silverado EV, and 2022 GMC Hummer EV Pickup vehicles. The high voltage battery may have an improperly secured internal module component.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Improperly Secured Ignition Coil Ground Bolt (42 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2027 Genesis G80 vehicles. The ignition coil ground bolt may be loose, resulting in an engine misfire or stall while driving.

title: Alamo Group Inc.: Solar Panel May Partially Detach (110 affected)
summary: Alamo Group, Inc. (Royal Truck) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Royal Truck & Equipment Class 2 Traffic Control trucks equipped with a Wanco sign board. The solar panel screws may loosen, resulting in a partial detachment.
